selected_evidence.summary: The policy was installed; modprobe returned failure and usb_storage remained unloaded.

selected_evidence.requirement: Prevent usb-storage from loading after reboot
selected_evidence.summary: The policy was embedded in initramfs and remained effective after reboot; post-reboot modprobe failed and the module stayed unloaded.

Healthy baseline boot ID 34027437-307c-4f58-bdb2-1fe626bb2d66 was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID a08c6134-975b-4083-a265-6dcfafccc098 observed, and node1 recovered with system state running, zero failed units, writable root filesystem, persistent policy present, and usb-storage still blocked.
